verdict.rationale: Codex ships a desktop app, launched via `codex app`, and community users mention the native app release, though they note it is Mac-only. Separately, Codex documents parallel task runs and inspecting diffs, but those docs describe the cloud/web surface, not the desktop app. Missing for 10: documentation that the desktop app itself offers visual diff review, evidence of side-by-side multi-session work inside the app, cross-platform availability, and hands-on corroboration of these app features.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review diffs visually and run multiple sessions side by side in a desktop app

citations.quote: If you want the desktop app experience, run codex app or visit the Codex App page.
Inspect the summary and diff, request a follow-up, or open a pull request when the result is ready.
Run tasks in parallel without tying up your local machine.
